propFaq1Q: How to pass a prop firm challenge?
propFaq1A: Passing a prop firm challenge requires strict risk management, consistent position sizing, and tracking your drawdown limits in real time. Key strategies include: trading only high-probability setups, never risking more than 1-2% per trade, tracking your daily and overall drawdown continuously, and maintaining consistency in your lot sizing. TradifyApp automates the tracking so you can focus on execution.
propFaq2Q: What is a prop firm challenge tracker?
propFaq2A: A prop firm challenge tracker monitors your progress against the specific rules set by your proprietary trading firm — profit targets, maximum drawdown limits, daily loss limits, consistency requirements, minimum trading days, and time limits. TradifyApp tracks all these metrics in real time with visual gauges, alerts, and AI-powered risk warnings.
propFaq3Q: How does trailing drawdown tracking work?
propFaq3A: Trailing drawdown tracks your maximum allowed loss from your highest account balance (the high water mark). As your account grows, the trailing drawdown level moves up with it. TradifyApp automatically calculates this in real time, showing you exactly how much room you have before breaching the limit.
propFaq4Q: Which prop firms does TradifyApp support?
propFaq4A: TradifyApp includes presets for FTMO, MyFundedFX, The Funded Trader, and other popular prop firms. You can also create fully custom configurations with your own rules, targets, and limits for any proprietary trading firm.

propCtaSub: Don't let preventable mistakes cost you another prop firm challenge. Start tracking your drawdowns, targets, and consistency today.
